The first [[Death|casualty]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Ghorman Massacre]] on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]]<ref name="Who" /> in [[2 BBY]]<ref name="Death" /> was a young and inexperienced '''individual''' serving as an [[Imperial security trooper]] under the [[Bloy's riot squad|command]] of [[Sergeant]] [[Bloy]]. He was shot and killed by an [[Unidentified Imperial sniper|Imperial sniper]] under orders from Imperial [[Captain]] [[Kaido]] and [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] in order escalate a protest in [[Palmo Plaza]] to violence, which succeeded when Bloy ordered his [[squad]] to open fire on the crowd in retaliation. The [[trooper]] was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] with light skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]].<ref name="Who" />
